title: Subagent Thread Forking & Safety Auditing with guardian-v2

claims.assertion: Complex safety verification, prompt injection screening, and risk scoring should run in forked subagent threads to avoid polluting parent conversational state

context: Executing safety checks within the main conversation loop introduces token bloat, risk of prompt injection leakage into assistant memory, and complex rollback logic.
distilled_learning: Use subagent thread forking (spawn_subagent(forked_from_thread_id, ...)) to spawn ephemeral child threads for synchronous and asynchronous safety evaluations, preserving primary thread isolation.
